wordAcceptance: No frequency threshold for dictionary-recognized words. Unrecognized loans/slang require an exact wordfreq entry with Zipf >= 2.2, or explicit review. Corpus fragments are not admitted using inferred compound frequency.
lemmaComposition: 85% normalized headword + 15% normalized weighted form mean; normalized. Without headword use normalized form mean.

projection.method: Orthogonal Procrustes on shared lemmas with Zipf >= 3
